description: Display inventory-level quadrant for a marketplace over ONE period, from the daily display quadrant fact: per inventory (page_type + ad_unit) average request count, response rate (%), impression/response ratio (%), currency-converted spend, budget-utilisation (%), and the distinct active campaign and merchant counts serving that inventory. Grouped by page_type + ad_unit. page_type is an optional per-call filter. Only inventories with >1000 requests over the period are returned. Called once per period; run current + baseline to compare.

requests.selector: ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(q.request_count / COALESCE(s.n_rows, 1)), COUNT(DISTINCT FORMAT('%T|%T', COALESCE(q.page_type, ''), COALESCE(q.ad_unit_name, '')))), 2)

response_rate.selector: CASE WHEN ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(q.response_percentage / COALESCE(s.n_rows, 1)), COUNT(DISTINCT FORMAT('%T|%T', COALESCE(q.page_type, ''), COALESCE(q.ad_unit_name, '')))), 2) > 100 THEN 100 ELSE ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(q.response_percentage / COALESCE(s.n_rows, 1)), COUNT(DISTINCT FORMAT('%T|%T', COALESCE(q.page_type, ''), COALESCE(q.ad_unit_name, '')))), 2) END
response_rate.description: Response rate (%) = non-zero responses / requests * 100 for this inventory, capped at 100.

impression_responses_ratio.selector: CASE WHEN ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(q.impression_responses_ratio / COALESCE(s.n_rows, 1)), COUNT(DISTINCT FORMAT('%T|%T', COALESCE(q.page_type, ''), COALESCE(q.ad_unit_name, '')))), 2) > 100 THEN 100 ELSE ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(q.impression_responses_ratio / COALESCE(s.n_rows, 1)), COUNT(DISTINCT FORMAT('%T|%T', COALESCE(q.page_type, ''), COALESCE(q.ad_unit_name, '')))), 2) END

spend.selector: ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(q.cost / COALESCE(s.n_rows, 1)), COUNT(DISTINCT FORMAT('%T|%T', COALESCE(q.page_type, ''), COALESCE(q.ad_unit_name, '')))), 2)
spend.description: Ad spend for this inventory over the period, converted to the marketplace currency.

budget_utilisation_perc.selector: CASE WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(q.daily_budget / COALESCE(s.n_rows, 1)), COUNT(DISTINCT FORMAT('%T|%T', COALESCE(q.page_type, ''), COALESCE(q.ad_unit_name, '')))) < SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(q.cost / COALESCE(s.n_rows, 1)), COUNT(DISTINCT FORMAT('%T|%T', COALESCE(q.page_type, ''), COALESCE(q.ad_unit_name, '')))) OR ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(q.budget_utilisation_perc / COALESCE(s.n_rows, 1)), COUNT(DISTINCT FORMAT('%T|%T', COALESCE(q.page_type, ''), COALESCE(q.ad_unit_name, '')))), 2) > 100 THEN 100 ELSE ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(q.budget_utilisation_perc / COALESCE(s.n_rows, 1)), COUNT(DISTINCT FORMAT('%T|%T', COALESCE(q.page_type, ''), COALESCE(q.ad_unit_name, '')))), 2) END

uniq_campaigns_count.selector: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.spend > 0 THEN s.campaign_id END)

uniq_merchant_count.selector: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.spend > 0 THEN s.merchant_id END)

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM (SELECT qd.page_type, qd.ad_unit_name, SUM(qd.requests) AS request_count, SUM(qd.responses) AS response_count, CASE WHEN SUM(qd.requests) > 0 THEN SUM(qd.responses) * 100.0 / SUM(qd.requests) ELSE 0 END AS response_percentage, COALESCE(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(qd.impressions), SUM(qd.responses)), 0) AS impression_responses_ratio, SUM(qd.cost_usd * scc.conversion_factor) AS cost, SUM(qd.daily_budget_usd * scc.conversion_factor) AS daily_budget, CASE WHEN SUM(qd.daily_budget_usd) > 0 THEN SUM(qd.cost_usd) * 100.0 / SUM(qd.daily_budget_usd) ELSE 0 END AS budget_utilisation_perc FROM reporting.os_display_ads_daily_quadrant_report AS qd INNER JOIN reporting.agencies AS a ON a.marketplace_client_id = qd.marketplace_client_id AND a.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' INNER JOIN reporting.static_currency_conversion AS scc ON scc.from_currency = 'USD' AND scc.to_currency = a.currency WHERE qd.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND qd.page_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING SUM(qd.requests) > 1000) AS q LEFT JOIN (SELECT sx.*, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY LOWER(sx.page_type), LOWER(sx.ad_unit_name)) AS n_rows FROM (SELECT tr.page_type, tr.ad_unit_name, tr.merchant_id, tr.campaign_id, SUM(tr.cost) AS spend FROM reporting.os_display_ads_ad_targeting_report AS tr INNER JOIN reporting.agencies AS a2 ON a2.marketplace_client_id = tr.marketplace_client_id AND a2.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' INNER JOIN reporting.os_ads_db_campaigns AS c ON tr.campaign_id = SAFE_CAST(c.id AS STRING) AND tr.client_id = SAFE_CAST(c.client_id AS STRING) INNER JOIN reporting.os_ads_db_campaign_types AS ct ON c.campaign_type_id = ct.id LEFT JOIN reporting.os_ads_db_campaign_inventory_configurations AS cic ON SAFE_CAST(cic.marketplace_client_id AS STRING) = a2.marketplace_client_id AND SAFE_CAST(cic.marketplace_client_id AS STRING) = tr.marketplace_client_id AND SAFE_CAST(cic.client_id AS STRING) = tr.client_id AND SAFE_CAST(cic.campaign_id AS STRING) = tr.campaign_id AND cic.campaign_id = c.id INNER JOIN reporting.os_ads_db_status_types AS st ON cic.status_type_id = st.id WHERE tr.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND (ct.name = 'BLOCK_BUY' OR st.name = 'ACTIVE') GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4) AS sx) AS s ON LOWER(q.page_type) = LOWER(s.page_type) AND LOWER(q.ad_unit_name) = LOWER(s.ad_unit_name) WHERE q.page_type IS NOT NULL AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__ ORDER BY __ATTRIBUTES_ORDER_BY__ LIMIT __LIMIT__ OFFSET __OFFSET__;
